name: Edding Genor Group Holdings Limited
summary: Edding Genor Group Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of biopharmaceutical products in China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers GB491, a differentiated CDK4/6 inhibitor for advanced or metastatic breast cancer; GB261, a novel CD3/CD20 bispecific antibody which is in Phase III clinical trial for autoimmune diseases; and GB263T and GB268, tri-specific antibody candidates which are Phase I clinical trial.
